text: Reviewers have mixed opinions about the smell of the GreenFist Hydrogen Peroxide cleaner. One reviewer stated that added perfume caused an asthma attack and expressed frustration over the fragrance [S1], while another noted that it emits a nice orange scent instead of harsh chemical smells [S2]. Additionally, a third reviewer mentioned that it does not have an overpowering chemical smell or a truly fruity smell [S3].
